reason: The policy explicitly mandates authentication at the beginning of the conversation via email or name + zip code lookup. The user has provided their email address in response to the agent's authentication request. The find_user_id_by_email tool call is the required first step before the agent can provide product or order information. This is a single tool call, complying with the one-tool-at-a-time constraint.
policy_references: At the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity by locating their user id via email, or via name + zip code.
Once the user has been authenticated, you can provide the user with information about order, product, profile information
You should at most make one tool call at a time
